member.name: T:startup_project.Common.PublicReadCache
member.summary:
Keys and invalidation helpers for public read caches (Redis or in-memory ). Logical keys; StackExchange Redis prepends InstanceName from Program.cs.
Consistency strategy: DB is always the source of truth. After every write, the affected cache key is invalidated so the next read repopulates from DB. Short TTLs (2 min for public data, 60 s for per-user cart) bound the staleness window in case invalidation fails. All callers must wrap cache operations in try-catch — Redis being unavailable must never cause an API failure (graceful degradation to DB).
